subject: Scaffold mamba-mcp-hana package
description:
Create the package directory structure for `packages/mamba-mcp-hana/` following the monorepo conventions established by mamba-mcp-postgres.

Structure to create:
```
packages/mamba-mcp-hana/
├── pyproject.toml
├── src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── database/
│   │   └── __init__.py
│   ├── models/
│   │   └── __init__.py
│   └── tools/
│       └── __init__.py
└── tests/
    └── __init__.py
```

pyproject.toml must include:
- Package name: `mamba-mcp-hana`
- Python >=3.11
- Dependencies: `hdbcli`, `mcp>=1.0.0`, `pydantic>=2.0.0`, `pydantic-settings>=2.0.0`, `typer>=0.12.0`
- Console script entry point: `mamba-mcp-hana = "mamba_mcp_sap_hana.__main__:app"`
- Ruff and MyPy strict configuration matching workspace standards (line-length=100, rules: E, F, I, N, W, UP)

Also update the workspace `pyproject.toml` to register the new package member.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Package directory structure matches spec appendix 13.3
- [ ] pyproject.toml has all required dependencies and metadata
- [ ] `__init__.py` files exist in all Python packages
- [ ] Workspace pyproject.toml includes `packages/mamba-mcp-hana` as a member
- [ ] Console script entry point configured for `mamba-mcp-hana`

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Ruff and MyPy config aligned with workspace-level settings

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] `uv sync` succeeds with the new package registered

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: `uv sync --group dev` completes without errors
• Unit: Package is importable (`import mamba_mcp_sap_hana`)

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 9.1, 13.3
